按钮、菜单和提示文字的语言: Language of buttons, menus and hints
字幕、释义和文章翻译显示为简体或繁体中文；切换后马上生效，不用重新翻译: Show subtitle, gloss and article translations in Simplified or Traditional Chinese; switching is instant, no re-translation needed
界面语言、颜色和学习文字的大小。: Interface language, colors and the size of study text.
字幕、短语和单词释义翻译成这种语言。简体和繁体之间马上切换；换成其他语言后，已导: Subtitles, phrases and word meanings are translated into this language. Simplified and Traditional Chinese switch instantly; for other languages, click Translate again on videos you already imported
改为只用英文释义，不翻译字幕。: Switch to English definitions only, without translating the subtitles.
（没有短语对照）。第一次用这种语言时会先下载它的离线翻译模型。: (no phrase-by-phrase translation). The first time a language is used, its offline model is downloaded first.
字幕、短语和单词释义会翻译成这种语言，界面也会一起切换。之后可以在设置里随时更改: Subtitles, phrases and word meanings will be translated into this language, and the interface switches with it. You can change it any time in Settings.
离线词典、逐词释义和短语对照都可以用。: The offline dictionary, word-by-word glosses and phrase-by-phrase translations are all available.
不翻译字幕，只显示英文释义。: Subtitles aren't translated; meanings are shown in English.
接上 API（设置 → API）就能看到母语的短语对照和单词释义；没有 API: Connect an API (Settings → API) for phrase-by-phrase translations and word meanings in your language; without one, meanings are shown in English.
